# Quote review

A fictional quote review screen used only for onboarding regression checks.

## Prerequisites

Requires Node.js 22 and pnpm 10. No external account is needed for this fixture.

## Getting started

From the repository root, run `pnpm install`, then `pnpm dev`.
The development page is documented at `http://localhost:5173`.

See [the UI guide](docs/working-on-ui.md) for component responsibilities and checks.
